name: std::basic_filebuf<CharT,Traits>::showmanyc
intro: If implemented, returns the number of characters left to read from the file.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of characters available for reading from the file, or -1 if the end of file was reached.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
This function is optional. If not implemented, this function returns 0 (since the base class version std::basic_streambuf::showmanyc gets called)

Whether implemented or not, this function is normally called by std::basic_streambuf::in_avail if the get area is empty.

The name of this function stands for "stream: how many characters?", so it is pronounced "S how many C", rather than "show many C"

summary: If implemented, returns the number of characters left to read from the file.
